title: pipetree pipeline
description: A pipetree pipeline config. Every top-level key except `defaults` and `systems` is a layer.

systems.description: Systems by name. Tables reference them in `source.system`.

system_columns.description: Names of the audit columns. Read from the config but not used to select columns: pipetree stamps its fixed audit set on every table.
system_columns.title: System Columns

schema_policy.description: Schema drift policy for every table that does not set its own.
schema_policy.title: Schema Policy

Layer.title: Layer
Layer.description: A layer: a namespace for tables, not an execution barrier.

sequence_by.description: Source columns that order the versions of a key. The highest value wins.
sequence_by.title: Sequence By

delete_when.description: Spark SQL expression, true for source rows that are deletes.
delete_when.title: Delete When

delete_mode.description: What a delete row does: soft marks the row deleted, hard removes it (scd1 only), ignore drops delete rows from the batch.
delete_mode.title: Delete Mode

ignore_columns.description: Columns whose changes alone are written in place: no new scd2 version and no audit column update.
ignore_columns.title: Ignore Columns

system.description: Name of a system declared under `systems`.
system.title: System

object.description: What to read from the system: a table, entity or file name the reader understands.
object.title: Object

System.description:
A declared system. Connection properties beyond `type` vary per source
type (host, database, landing_path, ...), so they're captured as extras
rather than hardcoded here - `pipetree.sources` owns interpreting them.

type.description: Source type: csv, json, parquet, sqlserver, kusto, storage_stream, d365_export, synapse_link or custom. Other keys are passed to the source reader.
type.title: Type

System.title: System

table_schema.description: Schema the table is created in. Defaults to the layer name.
table_schema.title: Table Schema

source.description: Read from a declared system. Exactly one of `source` and `logic`.

logic.description: Path to a .sql or .py file, relative to the config. Exactly one of `source` and `logic`.
logic.title: Logic

business_key.description: Columns that identify a row. Required for scd1, scd2 and unknown_member.
business_key.title: Business Key

strategy.description: How the result is written to the table.
strategy.title: Strategy

merge.description: Options for the scd1 and scd2 strategies.

depends_on.description: `auto` reads the logic file; a list names parent tables (fqn or unambiguous bare name).
depends_on.title: Depends On

unknown_member.description: Seed one row with a sentinel business key for facts to resolve a missing key to.
unknown_member.title: Unknown Member

schema_policy.description: Schema drift policy for this table. Defaults to `defaults.schema_policy`.
schema_policy.title: Schema Policy

surrogate_key.description: Name of a generated integer key column (scd1 and scd2 only). The unknown member gets -1.
surrogate_key.title: Surrogate Key

Table.title: Table
Table.description: One table. Exactly one of `source` and `logic`.
